# Collion: Kai'Sa & ADC coaching

> Collion is one of only two Challenger Kai'Sa one-tricks: peak #2 Kai'Sa worldwide, #1 Kai'Sa in the minor regions and #1 Kai'Sa one-trick in KR, EUW and NA on onetricks.gg (November 2026). He offers 1-on-1 League of Legends ADC and Kai'Sa coaching in English, live on Discord, for 40 EUR per hour or 100 EUR for a 3-hour bundle (plus an optional data deep-dive of your recent ranked games: 20 EUR on a single hour, or 110 EUR for the 3-hour bundle with the deep-dive included).

## Coaching
- Coach: Challenger ADC from Hungary with a BSc and an MSc in Computer Science; the data deep-dive runs your ranked games through his own analysis pipeline. 2nd at the 2014 Hungarian LoL Nationals (512 teams).
- How a session goes: OP.GG pattern check, pick the games that show your weaknesses, full game review backed by statistics, you summarise and get a written bullet-point summary, optional live coaching.
- Focus: early laning phase, mid-game macro and teamfighting for ADC players. Kai'Sa players get champion-specific detail.
- Book: apply at https://collionlol.github.io/#apply (Discord name, OP.GG, what to fix; he DMs you on Discord, nothing paid until you have talked), or join https://discord.gg/yXxABBHcGC and DM `collion`.

## Student results (self-reported, November 2026)
- Emerald 4 to Diamond 4 in one month: jungle tracking gaps, teamfights, how to take fights with Kai'Sa.
- Platinum 2 to Diamond 4 to Master 100 LP over about a year, from two sessions: stop making emotional decisions, play more selfishly as ADC, teamfight positioning against enemy ability ranges.
- Gold 3 to Platinum 4 in about 6 weeks: laning wave management, situational Kai'Sa builds, playing for yourself, when to enter teamfights.
- Emerald 3 (hardstuck) to Emerald 1: early game, positioning and teamfight concepts.
- Silver 4 to Gold 2: Kai'Sa knowledge, training mode exercises, patient re-explaining.
- Gold 3 to Platinum 4: focusing on own gameplay, farming, tilting less.
- Full reviews: https://collionlol.github.io/#reviews
